name: Bazibo brand tokens, round 3: "Knipsel in kleur" (the cut-paper b) with the lettering and the palette of Kralen

notes.mark: the b lies on the board scrap (#d9663f); the four scraps underneath carry the other four group colours, so all five kinds of play are in the mark
notes.group-marks: logo/mark-<group>.svg puts the b on that group's scrap; the four scraps underneath follow the ring board, action, puzzles, learning, creative
notes.mark-contrast: the cream letter on a scrap measures 3.2:1 (learning) to 4.0:1 (creative) — shape contrast, over the 3:1 the brief asks; every scrap is 3.2:1 or more on the base and 3.3:1 or more on the ink
notes.second-cue: colour is never the only cue; every group keeps its own icon and its name
notes.wordmark: the wordmark is drawn, not set: no font is needed to show the brand name; the bead on the i takes the colour of the big scrap
